CommunityApplications.Profile:
Apps by Alex Stevenson-Price.
- **Slipmat**: self-hosted control and automation for Sonos. A web UI for everyday playback and grouping, plus presets that group speakers, set their volumes and shuffle several playlists together, started from the UI, webhooks, schedules or HomeKit.
For help, bug reports and feature requests, open an issue on the app's GitHub repository.
